stroke.$description: Line weights for box drawing, which the cell draws rather than the font (cairn 0116).

glyph.$description: The glyph painter: a fraction of the font size, so a line is weighted like the type beside it.

gap.$description: The space between a double line's strokes.

rule.$description: The rule painter: hairlines, whatever the font size.

gap.$description: The space between a double line's strokes.

attribute.$description: How emphasis is drawn. Reverse is a swap, so it has no value of its own.

bold.$description: Bold: the weight a heading or a label takes.

dim.$description: Dim: quieter text, not lower opacity.
